content:
Hello,

I have posted the pr https://github.com/google-deepmind/formal-conjectures/pull/4565 , but despite the lean proof building correctly and otherwise passing all tests, the CI run seems to get stopped on the build docs portion. This has happened twice, and am curious if this is because of a bug specific to my PR (doubted, as it is minimal in nature and follows the same format as other PRs, and also this issue can be noted in some other PRs such as https://github.com/google-deepmind/formal-conjectures/pull/4622, https://github.com/google-deepmind/formal-conjectures/pull/4567, and https://github.com/google-deepmind/formal-conjectures/pull/4548).

In each of these examples, the Lean project builds successfully before the documentation step is canceled. The respective CI runs can be seen here, here, and here. I believe this to be either an issue with the docs build CI itself or some sort of resource limitation imposed by the CI. Nonetheless, wanted to report here, and see if it possible to rerun the CI on my PR, in efforts of finding out more about this bug.

Thank you!

Thanks for the report! I'm aware of this and looking into a fix.
One step of this is the pending FC#4302, which should make the CI less flaky
Nice! After CI fix was merged it succesfully fixed my PR's CI build, and likely the others too. Thanks for the quick reply and fix!
